name: Saturdays NYC
why: The SoHo surf shop from 2009 that became a clothing label, now run from Australia with seven stores in Japan and Australia and none left in the US.
origin: Founded in 2009 in SoHo, New York (31 Crosby Street) by Colin Tunstall and Josh Rosen and Morgan Collett (press: Interview Magazine and brand site names no founders).
